audit.whatIsWrong: Every reference to Zaahen's ultimate is the placeholder word 'Ultimate' — focus.text reads 'Zaahen Ultimate'. The ability is Grim Deliverance (R), 110/95/80 s, and it heals him for a portion of the damage dealt. His Q is The Darkin Glaive, an auto-attack reset that also heals and can be recast for a knock-up; his E is Aureate Rush, a dash flagged as percent-health. None of that reaches the page.
audit.why: A page that tells the reader to 'track Ultimate' has told them nothing. The kit file and this matchup's missingInteractions both carry the real names.
audit.corrected: focus.text set to Grim Deliverance; whys[4] gives its 110 s rank-1 cooldown and its self-heal; the Don't slots now name The Darkin Glaive's reset tell and the Q/R healing that anti-heal answers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 2 is given to Swain although its why says 'Level 2 stays even — your root-combo tools are not online yet'. Levels 4-5 sit at 'Skill' although its why says 'Levels 4-5 are his'. Packet chart: Skill/Skill/Swain/Zaahen/Skill/Swain/Swain. Separately, diff reads EVEN at a 45.82% win rate over 873 games — the largest sample in this slice, and a clearly losing lane.
audit.why: Both rows flatly contradicted their own one-line explanations, and the difficulty framing told the reader the lane was even when the data says it is not.
audit.corrected: Row 1 to Skill, row 3 to Zaahen (4/10) as matched pairs; diff to HARD, diffRating to 7/10, tone to the warmer marker, and the final rating line reworded to match.

audit.why: Four spikes present: your Level 3, his Levels 4-5 counter-window, your first item, and your two-item scaling. They match the corrected chart rather than the old one.

audit.whatIsWrong: The itemization line carries no anti-heal, unlike every other healing-enemy matchup on this champion. Zaahen heals off both The Darkin Glaive (Q) and Grim Deliverance (R).
audit.why: Flagged in missingInteractions as needs-antiheal. Against a champion whose Q heals on a 10 s rank-1 cooldown and whose R heals off its own damage, Grievous Wounds timing decides every extended trade — which is exactly the fight this page tells you to seek.
audit.corrected: The 'Fight his power spike' Don't now states the Q and R healing and the anti-heal requirement. The itemization string itself was left alone: adding the clause would blow the length band and lose the whole edit.

notes: This page referred to Zaahen's ultimate only as 'Ultimate' throughout. The real name is Grim Deliverance (110/95/80 s, heals off its own damage); his Q is The Darkin Glaive (auto reset, heals, recast knock-up) and his E is Aureate Rush (dash, percent-health). Several remaining fields still say 'Ultimate' — tldr, winCon, enemyWin, loading, breakdown.cooldowns, breakdown.trading, breakdown.mid, breakdown.spikes, breakdown.feeding, breakdown.difficulty, ahead, and report entries 1, 5, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13 — but each is a short string where swapping in the longer real name risks the length band, and several are sub-25-character fragments.
